configurations.name: Run MARS (Bash)
configurations.command: java -jar "${workspaceFolder}/Mars/Mars.jar" nc "${file}"; echo; read -n 1 -s -r -p "Press any key to terminate..."; echo; exit

configurations.name: Run MARS (Bash) (Display Registers)
configurations.command: java -jar "${workspaceFolder}/Mars/Mars.jar" nc \$zero \$at \$v0 \$v1 \$a0 \$a1 \$a2 \$a3 \$t0 \$t1 \$t2 \$t3 \$t4 \$t5 \$t6 \$t7 \$s0 \$s1 \$s2 \$s3 \$s4 \$s5 \$s6 \$s7 \$t8 \$t9 \$k0 \$k1 \$gp \$sp \$fp \$ra \$f0 \$f1 \$f2 \$f3 \$f4 \$f5 \$f6 \$f7 \$f8 \$f9 "${file}"; echo; read -n 1 -s -r -p "Press any key to terminate..."; echo; exit

configurations.name: Run MARS (PowerShell)
configurations.command: java -jar "${workspaceFolder}/Mars/Mars.jar" nc "${file}"; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Press any key to terminate...'; $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') | Out-Null; exit

configurations.name: Run MARS (PowerShell) (Display Registers)
configurations.command: java -jar "${workspaceFolder}/Mars/Mars.jar" nc `$zero `$at `$v0 `$v1 `$a0 `$a1 `$a2 `$a3 `$t0 `$t1 `$t2 `$t3 `$t4 `$t5 `$t6 `$t7 `$s0 `$s1 `$s2 `$s3 `$s4 `$s5 `$s6 `$s7 `$t8 `$t9 `$k0 `$k1 `$gp `$sp `$fp `$ra `$f0 `$f1 `$f2 `$f3 `$f4 `$f5 `$f6 `$f7 `$f8 `$f9 "${file}"; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Press any key to terminate...'; $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey('NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown') | Out-Null; exit
